question: If the marked price of a towel is 85% more than its cost price and a discount of 20% is announced on it, then find the profit percentage.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Marked price = 185% of CP

After 20% discount ⇒ SP = 80% of MP

SP = 185 × 80 / 100 = 148% of CP

Profit = 148 − 100 = 48%

**∴ Answer = 48% profit**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked price = 85% more than CP

Discount = 20%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (100 − Discount)% ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let CP = 100

⇒ MP = 100 + 85 = 185

⇒ SP = 185 × 80 / 100 = 148

⇒ Profit = 148 − 100 = 48

⇒ Profit % = 48%

**∴ The correct answer is 48% profit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage

SP = CP × (1 + markup) × (1 − discount)

Profit Formula

Profit % = (SP − CP) ÷ CP × 100

Quick Tip

Convert percentages into multipliers.
